I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm that Marrow Fieldworks pickups now use Dock 14, and that this stays between the two of us.

I didn't save it to GBrain. That brain is shared, so a note there could show up in other members' searches, which would break "keep it between us." The record is the DM itself. GBrain had no other notes about the dock, though its search was running in a limited mode, so it could have missed something.
